s1.syndrome_frame: Chronic eye symptoms with progressive vision loss and conjunctival abnormalities
key_facts: Initial visual acuity was 20/20 OD and 20/30 OS
Vision deteriorated to 20/30 OD and counting fingers OS over time
Slit lamp examination revealed subconjunctival fibrosis
Slit lamp examination revealed symblepharon formation
Slit lamp examination revealed corneal neovascularizations
Slit lamp examination revealed conjunctival hyperemia
Conjunctival biopsy and immunofluorescent histology revealed an unspecific result
Patient underwent therapy with reduction in conjunctival hyperemia and corneal vascularizations

shortlist.label: Mucous Membrane Pemphigoid
shortlist.why_kept: Chronic eye symptoms with subconjunctival fibrosis and symblepharon formation

shortlist.label: Ocular Cicatricial Pemphigoid
shortlist.why_kept: Progressive vision loss and conjunctival abnormalities with scarring

shortlist.label: Ligneous Conjunctivitis
shortlist.why_kept: Conjunctival hyperemia and corneal neovascularizations with chronic eye symptoms

shortlist.label: Vernal Keratoconjunctivitis
shortlist.why_kept: Chronic eye symptoms with conjunctival hyperemia and corneal involvement

shortlist.label: Sjögren's Syndrome
shortlist.why_kept: Chronic eye symptoms with conjunctival abnormalities and potential for systemic involvement

raw.rationale: The presence of subconjunctival fibrosis, symblepharon formation, and corneal neovascularizations are characteristic of Ocular Cicatricial Pemphigoid, which is a chronic autoimmune disease that leads to scarring and vision loss.

rejected.label: Mucous Membrane Pemphigoid
rejected.why: While it shares some similar symptoms, Mucous Membrane Pemphigoid typically involves more mucous membranes beyond the eyes and doesn't as specifically match the combination of ocular findings described.

rejected.label: Ligneous Conjunctivitis
rejected.why: This condition is characterized by recurrent, chronic conjunctivitis with a distinctive fibrin-rich exudate, which was not mentioned in the case description.

rejected.label: Vernal Keratoconjunctivitis
rejected.why: This is a seasonal, allergic condition that primarily affects young males, with symptoms including itching, photophobia, and stringy discharge, which doesn't align well with the chronic, progressive nature and specific findings of this case.

rejected.label: Sjögren's Syndrome
rejected.why: While Sjögren's Syndrome can cause dry eyes and some overlap in symptoms, the specific findings of subconjunctival fibrosis, symblepharon, and the pattern of vision deterioration point more directly to Ocular Cicatricial Pemphigoid.
